{"subject":"Claim C020516 on hold: no EVV visit recorded for 2026-10-07","body":"Hello,

Claim C020516 (patient PT0110, service code T1005, 32 units, $153.60, date of service 2026-10-07) is predicted to deny because no EVV visit is recorded for this date. The claim cannot be fixed by editing it, and we should not bill it unless the visit is found.

Could you confirm whether this visit took place and was recorded in EVV? If it did, please send the visit details so billing can verify it. If it did not, please let us know so the claim can be closed.

This needs to be resolved before the claim is submitted, ideally before the filing limit. Thank you."}
